info.title: iapolitique API
info.description: API de la plateforme iapolitique : dépôt, filtrage, analyse et classement d'idées pour réduire les dépenses ou augmenter les recettes publiques.

get.summary: Checks the admin token (used by the admin pages to validate the token typed by the user).
A new ALTCHA proof-of-work challenge, to solve before submitting a form.

200.description: Défi à résoudre par le widget ALTCHA (valable 20 minutes).

304.description: Inchangé depuis la version en cache (`If-None-Match`).

304.description: Inchangé depuis la version en cache (`If-None-Match`).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order of the ranking (`score` by default).

parameters.name: territory
parameters.description: Territory name (part of it, accents and case ignored) or INSEE code, 120 characters.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description:
Search in the neutral titles and summaries (French, accents ignored, approaching
results when nothing matches exactly), 200 characters.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Ideas per page, 1 to 50 (20 by default).

post.summary:
Submits an idea: screened at once by the decision model, answered with its status and a
tracking token.

400.description: Consentements manquants ou vérification anti-robot invalide (`consent_required`, `altcha_*`).

get.summary:
Page of a published idea, with its current analysis, its score components, the summaries
of the integrated contributions and the rights of reply. The slug of an idea merged into
another one answers `301` towards the other idea (its `Location` and the body give its slug).

301.description: Idée fusionnée dans une autre : voir `Location`.

post.summary:
Submits an improvement or an objection to a published idea; once accepted, it triggers a
re-analysis of the idea.

400.description: Consentements manquants ou vérification anti-robot invalide (`consent_required`, `altcha_*`).

post.summary:
Reports a problem about a published idea. The report is screened, then reviewed by AI with
the other reports of the idea (at most once a day, at once for problematic content).

400.description: Déclaration de bonne foi manquante ou vérification anti-robot invalide (`good_faith_required`, `altcha_*`).

get.summary: Publisher details, version of the rules and dates of the legal pages.

The methodology: prompts, screening grid (with the thresholds in force), taxonomy, score
formula and their versions, read from what the service actually uses.
The OpenAPI specification of this API.

Administrative levels, categories, impact publics, labels of the enumerations and refusal
reasons.

post.summary: State of the idea, contribution or report behind a tracking token.

404.description: Jeton inconnu, expiré ou mal formé (`tracking_not_found`).

post.summary:
Deletes the text at once at its author's request (with what refers to it; see
`db::tracked`). Idempotent: a second call confirms the deletion.

404.description: Jeton inconnu, expiré ou mal formé (`tracking_not_found`).

post.summary:
Asks for a human review of an automated decision against the text (refusal or masking),
queued for the administrator. One request per text.

404.description: Jeton inconnu, expiré ou mal formé (`tracking_not_found`).

409.description: Aucune décision automatique à réexaminer (`review_not_available`) ou demande déjà faite (`review_already_requested`).

AdminLevel.description: Administrative level targeted by an idea (§6.2 `admin_level`).

AdminLevelItem.description: An administrative level and the category groups it accepts.

AiMarking.description: Machine-readable marking of the generated content (AI Act art. 50, §7.5).

ai_generated.description: Always `true`: title, summary, analysis and contribution summaries are generated.

analysis_version.description: Version of the analysis of this idea (1 for the first one).

notice.description: Label shown before every generated block.

challenge.description: Hex SHA-256 of `salt` followed by the secret number.

maxnumber.description: Upper bound of the secret number.

salt.description: Random salt with its signed expiry: `<hex>?expires=<unix seconds>&`.

AmountEstimate.description: An estimate with its detailed calculation (citing the sources `[Sx]`).

CategoryItem.description: A category, its group and the administrative levels that accept it.

CategoryRef.description: A category of `prompts/taxonomy.yaml` with its French label.

Confidence.description: Quality of the available data behind an estimate (§6.2 `confidence`).

ConfidenceFactor.description: A confidence level and its factor in the score.

ContributionKind.description:
Kind of contribution attached to a published idea (§5.4, §5.5). Keys of
`contribution_kinds` in `prompts/taxonomy.yaml`, plus `doublon` for merged duplicates.

ContributionSubmission.description: An improvement or an objection to a published idea (§5.5).

text.description:
Text of the contribution, 30 to 2 000 characters. Personal data is masked before
storage; the text itself is never published (only its neutral summary).

accept_licence.description: Acceptance of the licence clause of the rules (box never pre-checked).

accept_publication.description: « Je comprends que mon texte sera publié s'il est accepté » (box never pre-checked).

altcha.description: Solution of the ALTCHA widget (base64), accepted once.

ContributionSubmissionKind.description: Kind of contribution a visitor may send (§5.5); duplicates are created by the pipeline.

ContributionSummary.description: A contribution taken into account by an analysis: neutral summary, never the raw text.

taken_into_account.description: Whether the analysis changed because of it.

response.description: Answer of the analysis to the contribution.

message.description: Human-readable message, in French when shown to visitors.

EuroRange.description: Low, median and high estimate, in whole euros.

impacts.description: One entry per public of the taxonomy, in its order.

changes_since_previous.description: What changed since the previous analysis (empty for the first one).

title.description: Neutral title written by the analysis.

proposal_count.description: How many times the idea was proposed (merged duplicates included).

total.description: Ideas matching the filters, all pages included.

oneOf.description: How the search matched, `null` without search.

title.description: Neutral title written by the analysis.

annual_gain_eur.description: Gross annual gain once in full effect.

score.description: Composite score in euros per year (« score calculé par algorithme »).

proposal_count.description: How many times the idea was proposed (merged duplicates included).

IdeaRedirect.description: Body of the redirection of a merged idea to the idea it was merged into.

slug.description: Slug of the idea to show instead.

IdeaSort.description: Order of the ranking (§6.3): composite score by default.

text.description:
Text of the idea, 50 to 4 000 characters. Personal data (e-mails, phone numbers…) is
masked before storage.

oneOf.description: Administrative level targeted, if the author knows it.

territory.description: Territory concerned (free text, 120 characters at most).

accept_licence.description: Acceptance of the licence clause of the rules (box never pre-checked).

accept_publication.description: « Je comprends que mon texte sera publié s'il est accepté » (box never pre-checked).

altcha.description: Solution of the ALTCHA widget (base64), accepted once.

ImpactAssessment.description: Impact of the idea on one public of the taxonomy.

ImpactDirection.description: Direction of the impact of an idea on a public (§6.2 `impacts`).

KeyCount.description: Number of published ideas of one key (administrative level or kind).

cgu_version.description: Version of the publication rules accepted with each idea and contribution.

LegalPages.description: Day of the last update of each legal page.

LegalPublisher.description: The publisher (a natural person, LCEN art. 1-1); also the host of the site.

LegalVehicle.description: Legal instrument needed to implement an idea (§6.2 `legal_vehicle`).

MethodologyFile.description: A file of `prompts/` as used in production.

version.description: `version` of the file; none for the JSON schemas (versioned with their prompt).

MethodologyFileKind.description: Role of a file of `prompts/` on the methodology page.

MethodologyResponse.description: Prompts, grid, taxonomy and formula as used in production (§6.5).

analysis_schema_version.description: Fingerprint of `analysis.schema.json` stored with each analysis.

files.description: Full text of every file of `prompts/` (to display as plain text).

OriginalText.description: Masked original text of the author, shown apart from the generated content.

personal_data_masked.description: Personal data was masked automatically (`[donnée masquée]`).

PublicStats.description: Public counters. Aggregates only: no text, no identifier, no fine timestamp.

ideas_received.description: Ideas received and still known (texts deleted by their authors are not counted).

ideas_rejected.description: Refused by the screening (texts erased after 30 days, the count stays).

duplicates_merged.description: New ideas recognized as duplicates of a published one.

contributions_integrated.description: Improvements and objections taken into account by an analysis.

last_published_on.description: Day of the most recent publication (Europe/Paris).

RejectionReason.description: A refusal reason of the screening grid and the rule it applies.

ReportReason.description:
Reason selected by the author of a report (§5.6): keys of `report_reasons` in
`prompts/taxonomy.yaml`.

ReportSubmission.description: A report about a published idea (§5.6, §7.5).

details.description:
Optional details, 1 000 characters at most (personal data masked). Also accepted as
`precision`.

reporter_name.description: Optional name of the reporter (100 characters), kept 6 months, never published.

reporter_email.description: Optional e-mail of the reporter, kept 6 months, never published.

good_faith.description: Declaration of good faith (abusive reports are punished, LCEN art. 6 VII).

altcha.description: Solution of the ALTCHA widget (base64), accepted once.

ReviewOutcome.description: Conclusion of the AI review of the reports of an idea (§5.6).

ReviewRequestBody.description: Body of a human review request.

message.description:
Optional message for the administrator, 1 000 characters at most (personal data
masked).

ReviewRequestStatus.description: State of a human review requested by an author (§7.1).

RightOfReply.description: Right of reply published by the editor under the idea (LCEN art. 1-1 III). Plain text.

author_label.description: How the person replying is designated, as they asked.

RuleReference.description: Rule at stake in a decision, as sent to the author.

article.description: Article number in the rules page, e.g. `4.3`.

title.example: Une mesure pour les finances publiques

url.description: Relative link to the article, e.g. `/regles#critere-sujet`.

ScoreComponents.description: Components of the composite score (§6.3), « score calculé par algorithme ».

formula.description: The formula in French, as displayed (plain text, several lines).

amortization_years.description: Years over which the implementation cost is spread.

delay_half_life_months.description: Delay (months) at which the delay factor is halved.

ScreeningCriterion.description: A criterion of the screening grid with the thresholds applied in production.

instructions.description: Question asked to the decision model.

oneOf.description: Meaning of the answers of a `noul` question.

levels.description: Levels of a `score` question, lowest first (empty for `noul`).

pass_when.description: `noul`: the answer that passes the criterion.

pass_from_level.description: `score`: index of the lowest level that passes.

reject_below.description: Below this probability of passing, the criterion fails.

accept_above.description: From this probability of passing, the criterion passes; in between: second opinion.

thresholds_adjusted.description: The thresholds differ from `screening.yaml` (adjusted by the editor for calibration).

reason_message.description: Message given to the author when this criterion causes a refusal.

ScreeningSection.description: The criteria applied to one kind of text, in the order of evaluation.

SourceReference.description:
A source cited by the analysis. Its URL comes from the AI: render it as a link only when
its scheme is `https:` or `http:` (§14.1).

StatementOfReasons.description: Statement of reasons, given with a refusal and on the tracking page.

reason_message.description: Explanation in French, with an invitation to rephrase for a refusal.

automated.description: The decision was taken automatically by an AI, without human review.

second_opinion.description: The decision followed a Mistral second opinion (gray zone).

purge_on.description: Day from which the text is erased, when an erasure is scheduled.

status.description:
Status right after the synchronous screening: `accepted`, `rejected`,
`second_opinion` (« en cours de vérification ») or `submitted` (decision model
unavailable: the screening is retried, follow it with the tracking link).

tracking_token.description:
Tracking token (256 bits, base64url), returned only this once: the tracking link is
`/suivi#<token>`.

reason_message.description: Refusal explanation in French, with an invitation to rephrase.

oneOf.description: Statement of reasons of a refusal (DSA art. 17).

TargetKind.description: Kind of entity screened by the decision model or reachable through a tracking link.

TaxonomyItem.description: An entry of a taxonomy list.

TrackedIdea.description: Published idea concerned by the tracked text.

status.description:
Status of the text (`domain::status`: `submitted`, `second_opinion`, `accepted`,
`published`, `rejected`…), or `deleted` once erased by its author.

oneOf.description:
Published idea: the idea itself, the idea a duplicate was merged into, or the idea
concerned by a contribution or a report.
Statement of reasons of an automated decision against the text (refusal, masking).
Outcome of the AI review of a report.

TrackedReviewRequest.description: Human review requested by the author.

token.description: Tracking token (43 base64url characters), from the fragment of the tracking link.

YesNoLabels.description: Answers of a yes/no criterion, as described to the decision model.
